verdict.rationale: SvelteKit (Svelte's framework) is designed around server load functions feeding data into components, and one community comment corroborates this being clear post-restructuring, but the evidence pack lacks first-party documentation describing the load()/data-flow mechanism explicitly. Missing for 10: official docs on SvelteKit load functions, server/client data-passing examples, and independent verification of async server components streaming to client components.
